name: Domain proposal

title: "[Domain] "

## The operational problem

What decision or task is painful today? Describe it in plain language.

## Who has this problem

What kind of business or role is it (for example, a pharmacy owner, a
warehouse manager, a farm cooperative)? Rough size and industry help.

## Current workflow

How do you handle it now (spreadsheets, paper, memory, another tool)?
What goes wrong or costs you time and money?

## Data available

What data exists that could inform the decision? For each source, note
the format (CSV, spreadsheet, PDF, system export) and how often it
changes. **Do not paste real customer or sensitive business data here.**
This issue is public.

## What a good recommendation looks like

If Kuki could tell you one thing every day or week, what would it be?
For example: "reorder X from supplier Y by Friday."

## Anything else

Links, examples, constraints, or related issues.
